decisions.reason: Adding 5V-rail current measurement does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its role as the normal 3.3V source.
The source identifies the existing 5V loads to justify metering but does not change the boost converter, enable control, powered loads, or standby policy.
Monitoring an additional rail does not change the AXP2101 battery input or normal system power path.
The 5V current-metering decision does not affect battery NTC sensing or thermal protection.
The source does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or protection-component requirements.
The power-metering change neither resolves nor changes the battery connector family, pin functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
Mention of LEDs as a heavy 5V load does not change the charge-status display or dedicated charge-LED interface.
The new 5V metering coverage does not change the standalone USB-powered 3.3V rail, its regulator, activation condition, or source selection.
The LEDs are cited only as consumers motivating 5V current measurement; their supply, data interface, and standby control remain unchanged.
The current-metering expansion does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or variant.
The source does not alter USB enumeration, flashing, connector requirements, or USB data routing.
The client requests 5V current measurement but does not specify any necessary change to the existing interboard connectors, pinout, or interface partition.
